text.en: This weapon lobs explosive slugs. When you're aiming down sights, the slugs travel fast and straight. When you're firing from the hip, the explosion is larger and applies Scorch to the target.

Hip-fired shots become slow traveling projectiles that deal splash damage in a 4 meter radius and apply 5 <solar/>Scorch stacks (10 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes).

Aiming Down Sights shoots hitscan projectiles that deal splash damage in a 2 meter radius.

Hip-fired shots become slow traveling projectiles that deal up to <pve 55 /> <pvp [?] /> splash damage in a 3.5 meter radius, down to 0% at the edge of the radius, and apply 5 <solar/>Scorch stacks (10 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes).

Aiming Down Sights shoots hitscan projectiles that deal splash damage in a 3 meter radius.
